notes: A budget page that is almost entirely one table. Line 0 is the running head and 34 the page number. Line 1 is the page's main heading and line 2 the table's -- BOTH are Section-header, because this is page 88 and a document has one Title. That is the deliberate trap for a size-based heuristic, which has no way to know it is not on page one. Lines 3-33 are cell contents, labelled Table: the tool produces no table element without an injected model, so this page measures what a missing table model costs rather than what the heading heuristic gets wrong.
